newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's NLCF buys 15,000T of palm kernel meal.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's NLCF buys 15,000T of palm kernel meal.

text.p: South Korea's National Livestock Cooperatives Federation (NLCF) bought 10,000 tonnes of palm kernel meal on Tuesday from Toepfer at $77.88 a tonne, C&F, an NLCF official said.
The official said the NLCF bought another 5,000 tonnes of palm kernel meal from Peter Cremer at $76.78 a tonne, C&F.

Meanwhile, the NLCF bought 3,000 tonnes of Argentine wheat bran pellet from Continental Grain at $118.00 per tonne, C&F, but passed on another 17,000 tonnes due to higher-than-expected prices, the official said.
It will re-invite tender to buy 17,000 tonnes of wheat bran pellet on August 26.
He said the NLCF was negotiating with sellers to buy 40,000 tonnes of soymeal.
Traders said the lowest offer was made by Cargill at $287.40 a tonne, C&F.
